scope: Chip-level pad ring around the ADC core of floorplan.json: pad order and cells, supply and pin connections, ADC placement, pad-to-core routes, pad decoupling, core VSS ring, ESD clamps and the reserved regions in the ring opening. Die coordinates; floorplan.json io_ring links here.
rule_source: TSMC N28 General I/O Library Application Note v1.4 (section numbers cited; the note itself stays outside git).
die_note: IO-cell outline from the generator (9 x 60 um + 2 x 110 um corners). PAD60GU pad metal extends 11.66 um beyond each edge, a 783.32 x 783.32 um envelope (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#18); the seal ring and scribe lane add to that.

domains.ana: Core-voltage analog domain: AVDD/AVSS on PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC, whose pads are the TACVDD/TACVSS bus and whose core ports (AVDD_CORE/AVSS_CORE) feed the ADC; VINP, VINN and two VREFP and two VREFN pads on PDB3AC; one PVSS2AC for the global VSS bus. Top, left_0..6 and right_8.
domains.dig: Separate-ground digital domain: DVDD (PVDD1DGZ x3), VSS (PVSS1DGZ), VDDIO (PVDD2POC + PVDD2DGZ), VSSIO (PVSS2DGZ x4, both sides of each digital corner); D0-D7 out on PRUW08SDGZ (8 mA, slew-limited), SAMPLE in on PDDW16SDGZ (Schmitt input, pull-down). left_7..8, bottom, right_0..7.

sso.rule: App note 7.3 and checklist 19-20: in each digital domain, bonded VSSPST cells (PVSS2DGZ/PVSS3DGZ) >= the sum of the driving factors (DF) of all bidirectional cells, each counted as an output, and bonded VDDPST cells (PVDD2DGZ/PVDD2POC) >= that sum / 1.1. Layout check enforces it.
sso.source: tphn28hpcpgv18 databook 170a, corner FFG0P99V1P98VM40C (the worst-SSN corner), Tables 5.3 (no slew control) and 5.4 (slew-rate enabled)
sso.basis: 2.1 nH is the databook column nearest the 2 nH per bond of the Stage 6 package model; 5 pF, the smallest tabulated load, gives the largest DF.
sso.sensitivity: With 5.2 nH bonds the DFs are 0.751 and 0.339: the 2 VDDIO pads then hold only for loads of about 30 pF or more (DF 0.412 and 0.135). Recheck against the real package before bonding.

route_rules.check: python -m Layout check (Layout/planning.py io_ring) validates this plan: the pad ring rules of the application note (one block per domain, corner and cut neighbours, cell counts, one POC, one global VSS label, VSSPST and VDDPST cells for simultaneous switching); route ends on their pad core pin, ADC pin or region edge, carrying that pad's core net; distinct routes never touch; all stay in the ring opening and off the ADC core; analog and digital regions; own-branch decoupling that every supply route passes through; guard-ring crossing layer; no route on the core VSS ring's layer crosses it; mirrored routes; one route per ADC pin and core-connected pad; no route on a bonded digital pad net; and the ADC pins, core outline and die_bbox agree with floorplan.json.

reserved_regions.use: ADC core from floorplan.json (122 x 111 um), R0, its mirror axis on die x 410 midway between VINN and VINP.
2 um P+ ring with an M1/M2 strap on AVSS_CORE, centred 3 um outside the ADC outline, fed from the left_0 PVSS3AC at its north-west corner. Routes cross it on M3 and above.

Global VSS ring on M7 just inside the IO ring: joins the PVSS2AC (top_7) and PVSS1DGZ (left_7) core VSS pins and the register VSS into the core VSS mesh the app note asks for (8.2, 10.2). Pad routes cross it on any layer but M7; width from the ESD current-density table.
VINN/VINP on the low track, the analog trunk pair on the high track, analog_pad_decap and sar_pad_decap. No digital net.
Analog-branch AVDD-AVSS bulk between the VIN routes, on the trunk next to its pads; about 2 ohm ESR.
The four reference bonds as one interleaved bundle onto the ADC west edge, and the guard feed. No decoupling, no digital net.
XREF/CDAC-branch AVDD-AVSS bulk just below the ADC, on the pair routes; about 2 ohm ESR.
SAR-branch AVDD-AVSS bulk in the NE corner between its pads; about 2 ohm ESR; 30 um clear of the VINP route.
SAR AVDD/AVSS from sar_pad_decap to the ADC east edge above SAMPLE. No digital net.
Eight flip-flops on DVDD/VSS clocked by SAMPLE rising, with buffers for the pad I pins. D inputs 6 um from the ADC east edge.
DVDD-VSS decoupling for the register and the pad core-side logic; both register supply routes pass through it.
Q0-Q7 from the register to the east and south pads; DVDD and VSS to the register. No analog net.
D3-D7 along the bottom pads. No analog net.
PCLAMPC_H_G (100 x 22 um) between the analog trunk pads and the core: VDDESD = AVDD_CORE, VSSESD = AVSS_CORE (app note 10.7.1).
PCLAMPC_H_G between the left_5/left_6 pair and the core.
PCLAMPC_H_G between the SAR pair and the core.

analog.serves: Comparator and Bootstrap cells through analog_decap_slot (9.3 pF in core)

pair.serves: XREF gate drivers and CDAC through xref_decap (10.1 pF in core)

sar.serves: SAR macro through sar_decap_north and sar_supply_and_decap (8.25 pF in core)

supply_plan.pad_decoupling: About 100 pF AVDD-AVSS bulk per branch at 10 fF/um2 with about 2 ohm ESR, as the Stage 1 budget recommends (stage6_supply_model.pad_bulk_decoupling); 6 ohm feed limit between the bulk and the core.
supply_plan.reference: VREFP/VREFN: two bonds each on interleaved pads (left_1..4), four separate tracks onto four west-edge boundary pins in the same order. No decoupling at the pads or under the routes; the 8 pF between the rails and the two 15 ohm resistors are in the core.
supply_plan.analog_ring: TACVDD is AVDD and TACVSS is AVSS (PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC pads). PDB3AC signals stay within TACVSS - 0.3 V and TACVDD + 0.3 V (app note 9.2 note 3): VREFP and VIN at 0.9 V are inside that with AVDD at 0.81 V.
supply_plan.global_vss: VSS is the ESD bus on every pad's VSS pin; bonded on PVSS1DGZ (left_7) and PVSS2AC (top_7), whose core pins join the register VSS on core_vss_ring.
supply_plan.digital_core: DVDD (PVDD1DGZ x3, right_4 feeds the register) and VSS feed the output register and the pads' pre-drivers.
supply_plan.io: VDDIO (bottom_3 PVDD2DGZ, bottom_6 PVDD2POC) and VSSIO (four PVSS2DGZ) feed the output drivers; no core connection.
supply_plan.esd_clamps: Three PCLAMPC_H_G, one per AVDD/AVSS branch pair (app note 10.7.1 asks for at least one per core-voltage domain).
supply_plan.board: AVDD 0.9 V (3 bonds), AVSS (7), VSS (2), DVDD 0.9 V (3), VDDIO library post-driver voltage (2), VSSIO (4), VREFP 0.9 V and VREFN 0 V (2 each). AVSS, VSS and VSSIO meet only on the board.
supply_plan.power_sequence: Every supply on a power cell or PCLAMPC ramps in more than 10 us; VDDIO before or with DVDD; AVDD before VREFP/VREFN/VINP/VINN are driven, and off after them (app note 3.1, 9.2).

io_rules.decision: Supply cells and counts follow the TSMC N28 I/O application note: >= 3 bonded PVDD3AC, >= 1 PVSS3AC and a bonded PVSS2AC in the core-voltage analog domain; >= 3 PVDD1DGZ, >= 2 VDDPST cells with exactly one PVDD2POC, >= 1 PVSS1DGZ and >= 1 PVSS2DGZ in the digital domain; a bonded PVSS3AC beside each PCORNERA_G and a PVSS2DGZ beside each PCORNER_G; a 3AC cell beside each PRCUTA_G, cuts only along a side.
io_rules.basis: App note 3.4, 6.2, 8.6, 9.7, 9.8, 10.6, 10.9 and the chapter 18 checklist. Layout check enforces them.

die_frame.decision: 9 x 9 ring, 36 pads, 760 x 760 um IO-cell outline.
die_frame.basis: The rules above need at least 34 pads, and a 19-pad digital block fits two sides without a mixed corner only from 9 x 9. Supersedes the 7 x 7 plan.

analog_supply_cells.decision: AVDD/AVSS on PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC: the pads are the TACVDD/TACVSS bus and the core ports feed the ADC. No PVDD1AC/PVSS1AC and no separate AVDDR/AVSSR rail.
analog_supply_cells.basis: App note 9.3-9.5 and 10.6: PVDD3AC supplies both the macro and TACVDD; PVDD1AC is a dedicated feed needing three bonded cells per package pin. Supersedes the 2026-11-21 split of ring (3AC) and core (1AC) pads.

reference_bonds.decision: VREFP and VREFN on two pads each in the order VREFP, VREFN, VREFP, VREFN (left_1..4), each pad on its own track to its own ADC boundary pin; the two pins of a rail join inside the core ahead of its 15 ohm resistor.
reference_bonds.basis: Stage 1 budget (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#15); reference bulk at the pads raises the decision error.

adc_supply.decision: The ADC keeps its single VDD!/0 supply; the analog trunk, the XREF/CDAC pair and the SAR each have their own AVDD/AVSS pad pair, route and pad decoupling. The three AVDD pads also meet on the TACVDD ring bus.
adc_supply.basis: No netlist change and no extra supply-domain crossings.

data_output_cells.decision: D0-D7 on PRUW08SDGZ (8 mA, slew-limited, Schmitt input, pull-up) instead of PDDW16SDGZ (16 mA, no slew control); SAMPLE stays on PDDW16SDGZ.
data_output_cells.basis: Simultaneous switching (sso): with PDDW16SDGZ the 8 outputs plus SAMPLE sum to DF 3.84 and need 4 VDDIO pads against 2; with PRUW08SDGZ they sum to 1.55 and need 2 VSSIO and 2 VDDIO. Same pins and footprint (library readback), so no pad moves. I to PAD delay is about 1.5 ns at 15 pF (FF -40 C) against a 100 ns frame.

pad_gap_fill.decision: The 40 um gaps between pads keep PFILLER20/PFILLER20A filler cells; no unbonded dummy power cells.
pad_gap_fill.basis: Designer decision, as in the accepted 12 x 12 rings. The app note recommends dummy power cells for ESD (6.1, 9.8.1, 10.3) and checklist item 22 asks for them in digital gaps; this is a recorded deviation.

data_outputs.decision: D0-D7 reach the pads through an output register on DVDD clocked by SAMPLE rising. The ADC's D0-D7 ports drive ADC_D0-ADC_D7; D0-D7 name only the bonded pad nets.
data_outputs.basis: D0-D7 are SAR next-word nodes that change bit by bit during conversion.

open_items: Bus resistance (app note Tables 8.1 and 10.1, checklist 23y.3): VSS bus from each PDB3AC to its nearest bonded VSS supply below 1 ohm, and the cell-to-cell limits in each domain; needs the IO-cell bus widths and sheet resistance.

Secondary ESD (app note 9.2 notes 4-5, checklist 23y.6): VREFP/VREFN get the 15 ohm resistors plus a diode pair to AVDD_CORE/AVSS_CORE on the trunk side in vref_decap_west; VINP/VINN need a secondary device or a check of the Bootstrap switch layout against the DRM ESD drain guideline.
Core VSS ring and VSS stubs: width from the DRM maximum ESD current density table; keep the ring off M7 tracks the in-core D0-D7/SAMPLE routes use at the ADC edge.

Pad geometry from the saved masters (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#18): bond-opening centres 22.34 um from the frame edge, 32.66 um outward of bond_pad_center_um; supply, reference and VIN core pins are cell-centre estimates (AVDD centrelines fall between M2 supply fingers). Derive landings from the placed masters' terminal polygons.
Feed widths: the 9 x 9 rail budget (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#27, constraints.json) sets at least 4.8 um M8 for the pair route and 6.3 um for the SAR feed; EM at the pin peaks is still to check.
ADC_D0-ADC_D7 load (route over the SAR plus the register input, about 8-10 fF per bit) and register hold at FF -40/125 C.
Cross-domain interfaces: SAMPLE (DVDD to VDD!) and ADC_D0-ADC_D7 (VDD! to DVDD); review them with the ESD rules.

Ring cell in OA (SAR_ADC_T28_LAYOUT/sar8_io_ring): label the POC rail, and run chip-level DRC, LVS and ERC once the ADC is assembled in it (Layout/results/io_ring_verification.json open_items; its ERC results are waived there).
floorplan_link: floorplan.json die_bbox, io_ring and the ADC.*@* boundary pins (pins_um, unrouted_pins) come from this plan.
